import pathlib, subprocess, json, os, statistics, sys, hashlib, platform
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from compare_parquet_engines import check_results
fixture=pathlib.Path('/tmp/peg-baseline.zZwcQ3/bench.parquet')
work=pathlib.Path('/tmp/peg-string-memory-pass')
binaries={'before':pathlib.Path('/tmp/peg-string-memory-before'),'after':pathlib.Path('/tmp/peg-string-memory-after')}
rounds=[]
reference={}
for iteration, threads in enumerate((1,4,4,1)):
    for variant in ('before','after') if iteration<2 else ('after','before'):
        env={**os.environ,'GOMAXPROCS':str(threads)}
        args=[str(binaries[variant]),'-parquet',str(fixture),'-rows','1048768','-workers',str(threads),'-warmup','6','-runs','15']
        report=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(args,env=env,text=True))
        day=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(args+['-only','group_day_sum'],env=env,text=True))
        report['queries']+=day['queries']
        for q in report['queries']:
            if q['name'] not in reference: reference[q['name']]=q['rows']
            check_results(reference[q['name']],q['rows'],variant+'/'+q['name'])
        rounds.append({'round':iteration+1,'threads':threads,'variant':variant,'report':report})
        print('paired',iteration+1,threads,variant, {q['name']:round(statistics.median(q['times_ns'])/1e6,3) for q in report['queries']},flush=True)
cross=[]
for iteration,threads in enumerate((1,4,4,1)):
    output=work/f'cross-{iteration+1}.json'
    command=[sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/compare_parquet_engines.py'),'--parquet',str(fixture),'--threads',str(threads),'--warmup','6','--runs','15','--include-grouped-sum','--json',str(output)]
    log=subprocess.check_output(command,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'},text=True)
    print(log,flush=True)
    cross.append({'round':iteration+1,'threads':threads,'results':json.loads(output.read_text())})
heap=[]
for threads in (1,4):
    for variant,binary in binaries.items():
        args=[str(binary),'-parquet',str(fixture),'-rows','1048768','-workers',str(threads),'-warmup','3','-runs','5','-memory','-retain','4']
        report=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(args,env={**os.environ,'GOMAXPROCS':str(threads)},text=True))
        day=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(args+['-only','group_day_sum'],env={**os.environ,'GOMAXPROCS':str(threads)},text=True))
        report['queries']+=day['queries']
        for q in report['queries']: check_results(reference[q['name']],q['rows'],variant+'/'+q['name'])
        heap.append({'threads':threads,'variant':variant,'report':report})
result={'machine':platform.platform(),'baseline_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'rows':1048768,'parquet_bytes':fixture.stat().st_size,'parquet_sha256':hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'method':{'paired':'same fixed fixture; alternating before/after order; worker settings 1,4,4,1; six warmups and fifteen samples each; before binary built before production edits','cross_engine':'same fixture and queries, worker settings 1,4,4,1, six warmups and fifteen samples each; engines sequential; warm disk cache; timings include result conversion; peGosus prepares once; DuckDB/Polars plan during execute/collect','heap':'separate five-run release/streaming/four-retained-result passes; Go allocated bytes include slab growth, not a process-memory comparison'},'source_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted([p for p in (root/'pkg').rglob('*.go') if not p.name.endswith('_test.go')]+[root/'scripts/compare_parquet_peg.go',root/'scripts/compare_parquet_engines.py'])},'paired_rounds':rounds,'cross_engine_rounds':cross,'heap_rounds':heap}
(root/'scripts/benchmark-results/2026-10-01-string-dictionary-pass.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Saved paired, cross-engine and heap measurements',flush=True)

import sys,pathlib,subprocess,os,json,statistics,types
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"scripts"))
from compare_parquet_memory import measure_process,ProcessMemory
from compare_parquet_engines import check_results
work=pathlib.Path("/tmp/peg-string-memory-pass")
args=types.SimpleNamespace(parquet=pathlib.Path("/tmp/peg-baseline.zZwcQ3/bench.parquet"),rows=1048768,runs=20,warmup=5,retain=4)
counter=ProcessMemory()
records=[]
for round_,order in enumerate((("before","after"),("after","before"))):
 for q in ("group_sum","top50","string_filter_sum"):
  reference=None
  for variant in order:
   r=measure_process(args,pathlib.Path("/tmp/peg-string-memory-"+variant),counter,"peGosus",q,4)
   r.update(variant=variant,round=round_+1)
   records.append(r)
   if reference is None: reference=r["rows"]
   else: check_results(reference,r["rows"],q)
   s=r["snapshots"]
   print("memory",round_+1,q,variant,round(s["steady"]["peak_footprint_bytes"]/2**20,2),s["gc"]["event"]["allocator"],flush=True)
(work/"paired-memory.json").write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+"\n")
counts=[]
for round_,order in enumerate((("before","after"),("after","before"),("before","after"))):
 for variant in order:
  r=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["/tmp/peg-string-memory-"+variant,"-parquet",str(args.parquet),"-rows",str(args.rows),"-workers","1","-only","filter_count","-warmup","8","-runs","31"],env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"1"},text=True))
  counts.append(dict(variant=variant,round=round_+1,report=r))
  print("count",round_+1,variant,round(statistics.median(r["queries"][0]["times_ns"])/1e6,3),flush=True)
(work/"count-confirmation.json").write_text(json.dumps(counts,indent=2)+"\n")
for q in ("top50","string_filter_sum"):
 out=subprocess.check_output(["/tmp/peg-string-memory-after","-parquet",str(args.parquet),"-rows",str(args.rows),"-workers","4","-only",q,"-warmup","8","-runs","200","-cpuprofile",str(work/(q+".pprof"))],env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"4"},text=True)
 (work/(q+"-profile.json")).write_text(out)
 print("profiled",q,flush=True)
